The fully charged native paid delta is `{1:+1, 3:-1, 4:-1, 6:+1}`; the byte-identical 17-stage caller multiplies it by 17. The saving is `H3 + H4 - H6 - H1 > 0`, including the new detour. The complete ordinary bound rises by 1,360 to 782,785,912; precision remains 2,430, with 68 owned labels, 74 lifetimes and peak 50.
